### Surface of section 

I am currently working on the analysis of the phase space.
For this I am wanting to understand the outer-most trajectory in the surface section with the condition $x=0$ and $p_x\geq 0$.

###
Our first constraint comes from the energy of the system.

$$\HH(x,y,p_x,p_y)=\Ekin(p_x,p_y)+\Epot(x,y)=E$$


###

To do this, the equation

$$\Epot(x,y)= \VHH $$

is considered for $x=0$ and $p_x=0$.

###

$$
\begin{align}
\Epot(y)\equiv\Epot(0,y) &= \frac{m \omega^2}{2}y^2 - \frac{\alpha}{3}y^3 \\
\Ekin(p_y)\equiv\Ekin(0,p_y) &= \frac{p_y^2}{2m}
\end{align}
$$

 so we consider the energies that pass through the surface section $x=0$ with maximal kinetic energy in the $y$ component, i.e. $p_x=0$ and 
 $$p_y=\pm\sqrt{2(\HH-\Epot(0,y))}.$$

 These trajectories move through $x=0$.
